extension.summary: Unofficial Spotify music plugin for Kodi, made for TVs
extension.description: Allows you to use your Spotify premium account to connect and play Spotify through Kodi. A fork of glk1001's plugin.audio.spotify with a TV interface for remote controls and faster listings. It has its own add-on id, so it can be installed next to the original.
extension.disclaimer: This product uses the SPOTIFY WEB API but is not endorsed, certified or otherwise approved in any way by Spotify. Spotify is the registered trademark of Spotify AB.
extension.news: 2.0.0: Own add-on id plugin.audio.spotify.tv and name "Spotify TV", so it no longer replaces the original Spotify add-on and both can be installed. Settings and sign-in are not taken over from plugin.audio.spotify. 1.3.15~tv26: Sharp Spotify logo in the header of the TV interface. 1.3.15~tv25: While Spotify throttles requests, lists show their last copy at once instead of waiting for minutes; preloading in the background pauses instead of waiting. 1.3.15~tv24: A like, save or follow in Kodi only reloads the library lists, no longer the whole cache. Likes made elsewhere no longer make all cached lists invalid. Context menus show the current saved and followed state. 1.3.15~tv23: Saved tracks and albums load with fewer requests, albums are cached (ideas by damnms). 1.3.15~tv22: Cached listings are no longer mistaken for up to date when their checksums collide (fix by damnms). 1.3.15~tv21: The focused row no longer moves or loses the cursor while other rows are still loading. 1.3.15~tv20: Merged upstream: plugin actions are allowlisted, auth tokens are no longer logged, an expired token signs in again. The own client id setting is now upstream's "user_client_id". Long track lists and grids have a slider on the right to page through them quickly. All playlists are listed while Spotify throttles requests. Tracks started while a video is playing are played as music, also from the classic menu and remote apps. Videos playing in the background stay in sync and are shown as a mini preview. New TV interface with synced lyrics, much faster listings, playlists preloaded, optional own client id with tabs and rows of tiles, made for remote controls. v1.3.14 (2025-02-10) Upgraded python 'bottle' module to version '0.14-dev'. Now works with python 3.13. 1.3.13: Changed default album retrieval for 'artists' to just albums and singles instead of everything. And added more logging to figure how many cached/non-cached things the plugin is retrieving. 1.3.12: Added a workaround setting "problem_with_terminate_streaming" to not terminate streaming early. Added for Raspberry Pi devices.
